cases.reproduction: Add the reviewed install(Activity) entry hook and then remove that exact hook from a copy; compare original and restored method bodies.
cases.cause: The 3-code-unit entry hook makes the existing one-code-unit alignment NOP unnecessary. dexlib transfers its line event to the following payload; removing the hook recreates the NOP but keeps that line event attached to the same payload.
cases.allowed_comparison: Only a LineNumber event on the unreferenced, unprotected, odd-address alignment NOP directly after a terminal and directly before its aligned payload may move forward to that same payload. Every value and event order remains exact.

allowed_audit_normalization.debug: Keep every event and its value/order/local-variable data. Require the same owning instruction. Permit an unchanged offset inside that instruction or a move from inside it to its start only.
allowed_audit_normalization.exceptions: Join only consecutive entries whose protected start and end are exactly the same, retaining the complete handler sequence. Require the same protected instructions, exception types, handler order, and handler target instructions.
not_allowed: debug-event omission, reordering, or changed values
allowed_audit_normalization.padding_line: Keep LineNumber values and ordering exactly. Only an unreferenced, unprotected odd-address NOP directly after an unconditional terminal and directly before its aligned payload may forward a line event to that same payload. Other debug events cannot qualify the NOP for removal. Reverse or executable-target moves are forbidden.
